::: {.obsidian-financial-statement}
:::

State the basis of preparation in one paragraph. Name the
accounting standards applied and the reporting currency.

# Income statement

State the revenue, the costs, and the profit for the period. Use a
table.

# Balance sheet

State the assets, the liabilities, and the equity at the period end.
Use a table.

# Cash flow

State the operating, investing, and financing cash flows.

# Notes

Give the notes that support the figures. One note per significant
item.
